nom: The Crème Shop Gelly Brightening Under Eye Patches

avis.texte: I honestly love eye patches!! And I love that these are pink!!
Similar consistency to a lot of the fancy collagen masks. This one is more for under eye which I will say feels great after a long day. The glitter is purely aesthetic but makes it fun.

When I looked tired in the morning, I would look forward to putting on these eye patches because it gave my eyes a lift in a few minutes. I liked to keep them cold in the fridge for extra vasoconstrictive effects and helped my eyes look wider and brighter.

Very refreshing and brightening feeling. However, if you have sensitive skin, I wouldn't recommend. Had some slight irritation and redness from it, nothing major but certainly not for those that could easily flair up from unfamiliar products.

I recently tried the Gelly Under Eye Patches from The Crème Shop and really enjoyed them. The patches have a cooling gel texture that feels very refreshing under the eyes, especially when my skin feels tired or puffy. After leaving them on for about 10–15 minutes, my under-eye area felt more hydrated and looked brighter.

These under eye patches are super cute. They have silver stars and are slightly glittery. As far as the brightening goes, I didn't notice any difference after a week. Might to use them longer to see results.
This eye patch is so smooth and so cute. It's pink with silver stars on it. It soothes your under eyes in the morning to start the day fresh. So good after a night out.
These eye patches are so cute! They really do brighten up your under eyes and are super moisturizing. I love that they're sparkly and have little stars ⭐️

I personally feel this product worked extremely well! As someone who struggles with finding good eye patches specifically to brighten my eye circles this is a great product. I also feel that the baby pink color, glitter, and glitter stars all make the product 100 times better. This will definitely be a staple in my everyday routine and I will be restocking soon.

These pink starry undereye patches are cute and refreshing! I'd leave them on after washing my face in the morning while I did other parts of my morning routine. I have dark undereyes due to thin skin, so it didn't completely relieve that. It did leave my skin moisturized and a little tighter feeling but not in a negative way. Applying makeup afterwards also went on nicer than usual.

[The Crème Shop sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program.] I really enjoyed using these eye patches for my puffy eyes. I always wake up looking like I got no sleep, and these eye patches are a quick fix to de-puff and brighten my eyes. The patches are thin and feel like you're not wearing anything at all, which is good if your eyes are sensitive. Although they are very cold when you first apply them so brace yourself for that! They have a subtle smell of strawberry that's not overpowering. I left these patches on for 10 minutes and tapped the excess serum under my eyes. I'm also glad they stay in place — I wore these while I was talking and they didn't budge. I recommend these eye patches!

avis.titre: Cooling gel patches that refresh, hydrate, and brighten
avis.texte: The Crème Shop Gelly Under Eye Patches are such a fun and refreshing addition to my skincare routine. The gel texture feels cooling and soothing the moment you apply them, instantly helping my under-eye area look more hydrated and awake. They sit comfortably without sliding around and leave my skin feeling soft, smooth, and refreshed. Perfect for self-care moments, before makeup, or whenever my eyes need a little pick-me-up.

avis.titre: Refreshing and Hydrating Under-Eye Patches That Actually Sta
avis.texte: I've been using the Crème Gelly Under Eye Patches for a few mornings and really like them. They feel super cooling and soothing when you put them on, and they actually stay in place instead of sliding down my face like some other patches I've tried. After about 15–20 minutes my under-eye area looks more refreshed and feels really hydrated. They also help a bit with morning puffiness and my concealer goes on smoother afterward. Compared to other under-eye patches I've used, these feel more comfortable and leave my skin feeling softer. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review, but I would definitely use them again and recommend them.

I think these do really plump up the under eye area and it feels nicely moisturized afterwards. I also let my brother try them and he loves them. I do have sensitive skin and if I leave them on for any longer than 5 minutes my skin burns a bit so I only leave them on for 5 minutes and I still notice an improvement. I feel like a lot of face mask and eye masks do the same since my skin is sensitive overall. I would recommend this to my friends and family. I did receive this product for free in exchange for an honest review.

I've been using the product mostly at night right after my skin care routine, and I've noticed a big difference with how puffy my eye bags are. The swelling has gone down a lot and they are not as dark anymore. I would definitely recommend these to anyone with super puffy eye bags!

These are such a cute and effective pick-me-up for tired under eyes. They feel cooling and hydrating, and I notice my under-eye area looks brighter and a little smoother after using them. Perfect before makeup or when I need a quick refresh. Plus, you get a lot in the jar for the price.

These eye patches are so cute but also work well de-puffing your under eyes especially if they are stored in the fridge. The gelly feeling is so nice as soon as you wake up but they are also super cute and girly to wear around!

avis.titre: They are good but would not buy
avis.texte: I think they are good but there is a better quality option at a similar cost!

avis.titre: I FEEL so cutesy with these on

avis.titre: Crème Shop Gelly Under Eye Patches
avis.texte: Super cute and fun way to add these eye patches into your skincare routine. I specifically like to use these at night time. I love that these come with so many patches! And the spoon is great to use to easily and conveniently separate them.

Just used these today and im already obsessed. A lot of eye patches tend to burn my eyes after a few minutes these left my under eyes feeling cool. I wore them while doing laundry and they didnt slip or slide at all which is a plus. I would say I noticed a slight brightness under my eyes after taking them off and the smell is subtle. Overall my undereyes felt so refreshed after. For the price these are definitely worth trying!

I had received this product to test out and I really enjoyed it! The eye patches feel nice and refreshing and leaves a little glow after removing. I noticed it also works well even right before applying my makeup, helps for a smoother looking undereye. I also appreciate the fact that it comes with a little spatula to scoop up the eye patches, a nice touch. Overall would recommend these patches

This is my first time trying under eye patches this cute. They're so glittery and hydrating. It has a minty cooly sensation which reduced my under eye puffiness. I use this in the morning to wake up. This product actually works and you can see visible notice within a week.

I've tried quite a few under-eye treatments, from gel creams to other brightening patches, and these from The Crème Shop definitely stand out for hydration and ease of use. Compared to other patches I've used, these feel more comfortable and stay in place without slipping, and they really help refresh tired eyes quickly. One of the biggest benefits of owning this product is how instantly uplifting it feels — they help reduce puffiness and give a brighter, more awake look in just one use. They also make a great prep step before makeup or a quick pick-me-up before an event. Would I buy this product again? Yes, absolutely! They're affordable, effective, and something I reach for whenever my under-eyes look dull or puffy. I would definitely recommend these to friends or family, especially anyone looking for an easy, budget-friendly way to brighten and hydrate the under-eye area — just keep in mind results are temporary like most patches, but the boost is noticeable!
I lovee using these! No irritation or redness at all. These are sooo cute and I will be recommending them to everyone
Hydrating and brightening under eye patches, thin enough to be comfortable yet stick with enough product leaving radiant skin underneath.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I think this product is worth purchasing. Each eye patch is pink, glittery and so hydrating. I put these on first thing in the morning or late at night for a little self care session.
used this in the morning and it instantly cooled my under eyes. felt very lightweight on the face and didn't slip. didn't leave a greasy feel and was super chill and relaxing.

I loved the product, not only is the packaging pretty but so are the eye patches themselves. They looked pretty and made my under eyes super hydrated and I def noticed some lightening. 100% recommend.

I love these eyepatches! They're adorable and soothing, and I use them every morning to help me wake up and depuff. I shared them with my teenage cousins and they love them too. I would absolutely buy more as little gifts!

I like how it is in a tub and not in a plastic wrap, the serum is so glistening, i am not sure if i like how they are so thin, but that doesn't matter because it really works, you can see change within a week
The packaging is super cute Light and thin patches that are super cooling and depuffing Smell nice and go on easily and stay in place because of how thin they are

I give this product four stars on bc they slip on my face. The eyes don't really stay in place so I have to keep pushing them back. Other than that, they smell great, work great, and they are so cute. I love how they put little stars in the patches.
these were amazing, and just what i needed to get me up and looking alive in the morning! i they left my skin glowing, and my under eyes looking hydrated

I recently tried the Gelly Under Eye Patches (Crème) and was genuinely impressed with how refreshing they felt. The texture is soft and cushiony, and they adhere really well without sliding around, which makes them perfect for wearing while getting ready in the morning. As soon as I applied them, I noticed a cooling, soothing sensation that instantly helped de-puff my under-eye area. After about 15–20 minutes, my under-eyes looked noticeably more hydrated and smoother. Fine lines appeared less pronounced, and my concealer applied much more seamlessly afterward. What I especially liked about the crème version is that it feels nourishing without being heavy or sticky. Once I removed the patches, the remaining serum absorbed quickly into my skin and didn't pill under makeup. Overall, these are a great quick fix for tired eyes—whether after a late night, a long flight, or when your under-eye area needs an extra boost of hydration. I'll definitely be keeping these in my routine for self-care days and special events.

I received this product in exchange of my review and I couldn't be happier. I use this product at the end of the day for a little self care, it adds that extra sparkle. Easy to use and hydrating, I will definitely buy again.

I got the products for free. Ive been loving creme products for a long time. I never tried their skincare, only makeup. I got to try the gelly under eye patches! They smell great and are soo pinky cute. 🥰 I love the coolness from the gellys. I can smell the strawberry in the patches. My favorite fruit. 🍓

I tried the Gelly brightening under-eye patches with strawberry extract, and they were very refreshing on my face. As they start to dry, they feel cool on the skin, which adds a really nice refreshing sensation. I've been using them every night before bed, and I think they work well because I wake up with less puffiness under my eyes. I also like that the strawberry extract doesn't make the product overly fruity. The scent is very light and not strong, which makes the experience more pleasant. Overall, they feel soothing, refreshing, and helpful for reducing puffiness

avis.titre: Really enjoying the Gelly Brightening patches
avis.texte: I've been using the Gelly Brightening Under Eye Patches from the CRÈME shop and I'm honestly impressed. They hydrate so well, help depuff, and leave my under-eyes looking brighter and more refreshed — especially on tired mornings. I want to say thank you to the CRÈME shop for sending me their Gelly Brightening under eye patches for free to review.

I have tried these patches a couple times and I like them. They stick pretty well on your under eyes although the shape is a bit too round to fit the contours of my particular face. I don't think I'll notice any cumulative benefits like brightening so I'm taking half a star off for that and the shape. Overall they're cute and serve the "performative eye patch" trend well :)
I like these patches. It helps with moisture under my eyes. I leave it on for 30 minutes or until it dries up and I've seen major difference in the dullness under my eyes.

These eye patches are super cute and very easy to put on. They make skincare fun. I put them on under my eyes when I'm getting ready and they leave my undereyes feeling moisturized and refreshed.

avis.titre: I would definitely purchase this product again
avis.texte: I received these Gelly Brightening Under Eye Patches for free in exchange for my honest review. I used them by applying them to clean, dry skin under each eye and left them on for about 15 minutes. They felt really cooling and refreshing from the start, and even though they're quite moist, once I applied them on a dry face, they stayed in place pretty well—just a tiny slip if I moved too much. My under-eyes looked brighter, less puffy, and they didn't irritate my skin at all. The only thing I didn't like was the little star glitter pieces—they tended to come off and fall out, which was a bit messy. I'd recommend leaving out the glitter altogether. Overall, though, I would buy them again—they're a great boost for tired eyes, and I'd definitely recommend them to my friends and family!
